ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic sentence means "The house is big." (1 mark)
   A. أَزْرَعُ شَجَرَةً
   B. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ
   C. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   D. الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ

2. Which Arabic sentence means "I am from Kenya." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ
   B. أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   C. اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ
   D. أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ

3. How do you read the syllable نَ? (1 mark)
   A. su
   B. tu
   C. na
   D. ta

4. Which is a non-verbal cue? (1 mark)
   A. A title
   B. A gesture
   C. A dictionary
   D. A spelling

5. Which letter has one dot above it? (1 mark)
   A. ي (yaa)
   B. ب (baa)
   C. ن (nuun)
   D. ت (taa)

6. Which Arabic word means "neck"? (1 mark)
   A. رَقَبَةٌ
   B. سِنٌّ
   C. جِسْمٌ
   D. بَطْنٌ

7. How is the Arabic word لِسَانٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. raqaba
   B. fam
   C. lisaan
   D. batn

8. Which is a good way of caring for household items? (1 mark)
   A. Wash cups and plates after use
   B. Throw books on the floor
   C. Leave a lamp near water
   D. Leave a knife within reach of small children

9. How would a girl say 'I am a pupil'? (1 mark)
   A. ismii tilmiidh
   B. anaa tilmiidh
   C. haadhaa tilmiidh
   D. anaa tilmiidha

10. What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي يَلْعَبُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. This is my father.
   C. My brother plays.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

11. What is the name of the Arabic letter ع? (1 mark)
   A. kaaf
   B. ʿayn
   C. Saad
   D. alif

12. Which Arabic sentence means "Do not play with the knife." (1 mark)
   A. لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   B. الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ
   C. الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ
   D. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ

13. Which Arabic writing style is used in most printed books and newspapers? (1 mark)
   A. Thuluth
   B. Naskh
   C. Kufic
   D. Diwani

14. How is the Arabic word اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. uktub
   B. ismaʿ
   C. ijlis
   D. ilmis anfaka

15. What is an inferential question? (1 mark)
   A. A question whose answer is not stated but can be worked out from clues
   B. A question about spelling
   C. A question with no answer
   D. A question whose answer is stated in the text

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: fii baytii matbakh (2 marks)

17. Describe two ways in which your class can look after the school environment. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Describe how to carry out a dictation of the days of the week in pairs. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Write four weather features in Arabic sounds with meanings. (4 marks) (4 marks)

20. Explain why neat and legible writing matters when a poem is displayed. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ
   الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

2. B — أَنَا مِنْ كينيا
   أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

3. C — na
   نَ is read na.

4. B — A gesture
   Gestures, facial expressions and body movements are non-verbal cues.

5. C — ن (nuun)
   nuun has one dot above. Baa has one dot below, taa has two dots above and yaa has two dots below.

6. A — رَقَبَةٌ
   رَقَبَةٌ (raqaba) means neck.

7. C — lisaan
   لِسَانٌ is read lisaan and means tongue.

8. A — Wash cups and plates after use
   Cleaning items after use helps them to last and keeps the home safe.

9. D — anaa tilmiidha
   A girl uses tilmiidha, with the ending -a. A boy says tilmiidh.

10. C — My brother plays.
   أَخِي يَلْعَبُ (akhii yalʿabu) means: My brother plays.

11. B — ʿayn
   The letter ع is called ʿayn.

12. A — لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ
   لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

13. B — Naskh
   Naskh is clear and round and is used for most printed books.

14. D — ilmis anfaka
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ is read ilmis anfaka and means touch your nose.

15. A — A question whose answer is not stated but can be worked out from clues
   For inferential questions you use clues in the text to work out the answer.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: In my house there is a kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Plant and water trees; put rubbish in bins; keep water clean; sweep the compound.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way and 1 mark for a reason.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: One learner says a day; the other repeats it, says the sounds and writes the letters from right to left; they check and correct together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying the day, 1 mark for writing and 1 mark for checking.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), riih (wind), matar (rain).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Readers can read it easily, the dots and marks show the right words, and neat work shows care and pride.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.
